TICKET
# Not able to change stock behaviour in shared stock

When I have activated multistores and set shared stock and try to change the stock behaviour to for instance "deny order when out of stock" it will only change in the database on the base product and not on the combinations. So when trying to add to the cart, this setting is not respected because the old setting is still present on the combination.

## Attendu
It should change all rows for that product.

## Étapes
1. Set up mutli shops with shared stock
2. Edit product stock behavioud setting on a product with combinations.
3. Check the database "stock_available" table, it will only change on the id_product_attribute=0 row.

- déclinaison (combinaison, variante, combination) → Combination, id_product_attribute, ProductAttribute, Product::getAttributeCombinations
